Review Guidde?

Reviewers mostly say Guidde makes how-to and training videos much faster and easier to create, with a simple interface, polished results, and useful AI help for annotations and voiceovers. People mention practical uses like onboarding, customer support, product walkthroughs, and internal knowledge sharing, especially for small teams. A founder from Wallafan says it helped them build step-by-step guides for users. The few recurring concerns are narration timing, limited voice and avatar options, unclear pricing for some features, and privacy questions around recorded data.

#### What's great

I use it to generate music videos for my songs and I have to say the editing timeline it generates is clear and friendly for a complete novice like me to navigate and become - moderately - proficient with.

I think it's aimed toward novices like myself, I cannot imagine that experts would find its UI or options would give them the fine-grain control they would need.

The back-end AI models it uses also seem to have improved recently - I've only been using Revid a matter of months but my "first draft" music videos it generates are much better now than they were even a few months ago.

Revid has been fantastic primarily because of its sheer simplicity and fair credit system. When you are producing a steady stream of animated music videos for a channel, you need a workflow that doesn't bog you down. The interface is incredibly intuitive, allowing me to combine my audio and visual assets and get straight to creating without a steep learning curve. Plus, the way it handles credit usage is very reasonable and transparent, meaning I can produce the volume of content I need without burning through my budget instantly.
